name: BLST — BLPA Live Scoring
description: Live scoring, stats and BLPA Factions for BLPA hockey tournaments, with an iPad-friendly scorekeeper and public live scoreboards.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Setup key for creating the first global admin account (Account → Set up admin). It stops working once an admin account exists. Auto-generated: Settings → Reveal Config Vars.

AUTH_SECRET.description: Keys the sign-in code hashes so codes in progress survive restarts. Auto-generated.

SMTP_URL.description: Email for sign-in codes, e.g. smtps://USER:PASS@smtp.postmarkapp.com:465 (any SMTP provider). Until set, codes are printed in the Heroku log.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender for sign-in emails, e.g. BLST <no-reply@your-domain.org>.

TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.description: Twilio account SID for text-message codes.

TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER.description: Twilio phone number that sends the codes, e.g. +15551234567 (or set TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID).

AUTH_LOG_CODES.description: "true" prints sign-in codes in the Heroku log instead of sending them, for testing before email/SMS are set up. Turn off once SMTP_URL and Twilio are set.

SEED_DEMO.description: "true" loads a demo tournament (4 teams, 2 finished games, 1 live game) on first deploy so you can try things out. Delete it from Admin → Settings when you're done.

PUBLIC_EXPORTS.description: "true" lets anyone call the export API (like the public scoreboards). "false" requires an API key.

SECURITY_CONTACT.description: Optional: where people should report security problems, e.g. mailto:security@example.org (published at /.well-known/security.txt).

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Optional: comma-separated websites allowed to call the API from a browser. * = any (default).

LEAGUEAPPS_SITE_ID.description: Optional: your LeagueApps site id (registration sync).

LEAGUEAPPS_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional: LeagueApps Private API key client id.

LEAGUEAPPS_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional: PEM private key from the LeagueApps .p12 (openssl pkcs12 -nodes -legacy -in <id>.p12 -out <id>.pem).

LEAGUEAPPS_SYNC_INTERVAL_MIN.description: Optional: sync LeagueApps registrations every N minutes (0 = only when you press Sync now).
